openings.location: Background, paragraph beginning Tests should be hermetic
openings.quote: Tests should be hermetic: that is, they ought to access only those resources on which they have a declared dependency.
openings.scope: Hermeticity is a dependency boundary; a finite environment differential is not proof of universal hermeticity.
